title: Privacy
description: What this site stores about you and why.

blocks.heading: What this site stores about you
blocks.body: Short version: nothing unless you sign in, and you can delete it any time.

**Without signing in**, your points, achievements and preferences (theme, palette, sound) are stored only in your own browser. Nothing about you is sent to the server, except anonymous visit statistics (see below) and an anonymous connection that counts how many people are online and shares your mouse pointer, without any name, with other visitors on the same page. You can switch pointers off in the achievements window.

**When you sign in** with Google, GitHub or LinkedIn, the site stores the name, email address and profile picture that provider shares, plus your points, achievements and purchases, so your progress follows you. I may use your email address to get in touch with you. It is never sold or shared.

**Visit statistics:** the site counts page views itself, without cookies and without storing anything in your browser. It keeps the page, where the visit came from (for example LinkedIn), the screen size group and the theme. Your IP address is never stored: visitors are told apart for one day only, by a code that cannot be turned back into an address and changes every day. Nothing is shared with any analytics company.

**Contact form:** a message you send is stored with the name and email address you type, so I can reply. Nothing else is collected, and it is never shared; ask and I will delete it.

**Deleting your data:** open the sign-in window and choose *Delete account*. Your account and all its progress are removed immediately.

**Cookies:** one cookie keeps you signed in, and one short-lived cookie protects the sign-in process. There are no advertising or tracking cookies.

Questions? Use the contact page.
